$comment: The render context for templates/display-manager/hypr-session.j2. ZERO variables: a fixed /bin/sh launcher for the Hyprland session. The empty contract is asserted against the body by `make validate-templates`, so a future interpolation cannot slip in undeclared.
title: display-manager/hypr-session.j2 — render context
description: No render context: the session launcher contains no Jinja expressions. It is a `.j2` because the consumer installs it through the template module.

x-render-contract.why_a_schema_for_a_variable_free_templat: The pairing rule is mechanical (`<name>.j2` ⇄ `<name>.vars.schema.json`), and the empty contract still fails a future `{{ }}` — see `lint-templates`' property/read equality rule.
x-render-contract.assets_scope: The file's mode and destination (/usr/local/bin, 0755) belong to the installer: assets carries content, never ownership (spine AD-9).
